## How to transcribe a video to text for free

Upload the video file (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI and more) from your computer or phone, choose the spoken language and click «Transcribe». Any2Text pulls the audio out of the video and returns a transcript with timestamps in minutes. The first minutes are free and need no signup — download the text as DOCX or TXT, or as SRT subtitles for your video.

## How to transcribe audio to text for free

Upload an MP3, WAV, M4A or any other audio file — a podcast, interview, lecture or voice recording — pick the language and click «Transcribe». The AI converts speech to text with up to 98% accuracy, and you can edit the transcript before exporting it. Your first minutes are free, no account or credit card required.
